notes.title: Demo Release
notes.content:
Dear players.
As we progress our alpha development with our web version, we are happy to announce that Steam Demo will be released on Steam on December. 

Demo version will be the full version under the name of "Demo".
Our goal is to gain players from Steam for the alpha process.

Join Discord for Alpha Process: [url=https://1387mmo.net/discord?utm_source=demoAnnouncement]https://1387mmo.net/discord[/url]
